T: Be the ball. Be the buffet.
D: Caddies, golfers and a groundskeeper at war with a gopher all clash at a snobby country club.
P: Serve the mains when Al Czervik starts making noise in the club dining room.
S: Three slices of toast layered with roast turkey, crisp bacon, lettuce, tomato and mayo, pinned with toothpicks and cut into quarters.
Carl's endless war on the gopher
A hollowed cob loaf filled with a hot spinach and cheese dip, baked at 180C for 25 minutes, the scooped bread toasted for dipping.
Caddy shack mini chilli cheese dogs

Cocktail franks in soft mini rolls, smothered in a quick beef chilli, melted cheddar and diced onion, served in paper boats. Brown 250g beef mince with half a diced onion, then add 1 tsp chilli powder, 1 tsp cumin, 2 tbsp tomato paste and 150ml water and simmer 15 minutes until thick. Simmer 16 cocktail franks for 5 minutes. Split 16 mini rolls, add a frank, spoon over chilli and top with 120g grated cheddar. Grill 2 minutes until the cheese melts and finish with diced onion.
M: the members' dinner at the club
Beef rib roast seasoned overnight, roasted at 220C for 20 minutes then 160C to 52C, rested 20 minutes, carved thick, with horseradish cream and a baked potato.
Al Czervik's garlic prawn surf and turf
the loud new money at the club

Eye fillet seared and roasted pink, topped with garlic prawns cooked in butter, chilli and lemon, with shoestring fries and a rocket salad. Season 4 eye fillet steaks of 180g. Sear in a smoking pan 2 minutes a side, then roast at 200C for 6 minutes to 54C inside and rest 5 minutes. In the same pan melt 60g butter with 4 sliced garlic cloves and a pinch of chilli, add 400g peeled green prawns and cook 2 minutes. Squeeze in lemon and add parsley. Spoon the prawns over the steaks. Serve with 800g oven-baked shoestring fries and rocket.
W: the snack bar by the pool
Vanilla ice cream, hot fudge, whipped cream, nuts and a cherry in a tall glass. Floating in a pool, never.
K: Nineteenth hole peach iced tea lemonade

Strong black tea steeped with fresh peach, cooled and poured half and half with fresh lemonade over ice, finished with mint and a lemon wheel. Brew 4 black tea bags in 500ml boiling water with 2 sliced peaches for 5 minutes, then remove the bags and cool with the peaches in. Make lemonade by stirring the juice of 3 lemons with 80g caster sugar and 400ml cold water. Fill four tall glasses with ice, pour in half tea and half lemonade, and add a peach slice, mint sprig and lemon wheel.

s.how: Grill 8 rashers of bacon. Toast 12 slices white bread. Layer 300g roast turkey, bacon, lettuce, tomato and mayo across three slices each. Pin with toothpicks and cut into quarters.

s.note: Carl's endless war on the gopher
s.how: Hollow a cob loaf and tear the inside into pieces. Wilt 250g spinach, squeeze and mix with 250g cream cheese, 150g sour cream, 50g parmesan and a crushed garlic clove. Fill the cob and bake at 180C for 25 minutes with the bread pieces around it.

m.note: the members' dinner at the club
m.how: Season a 2kg beef rib roast overnight. Roast at 220C for 20 minutes then 160C to 52C and rest 20 minutes. Bake 4 potatoes. Mix 2 tbsp horseradish into 200g sour cream. Carve thick and serve with the potatoes and chives.

w.note: the snack bar by the pool
w.how: Melt 100g dark chocolate with 100ml cream for hot fudge. Scoop vanilla ice cream into four tall glasses, pour over the fudge and top with whipped cream, chopped peanuts and a cherry. Keep it well away from the pool.
